description:
把《杀戮尖塔 2》原版的回合制战斗改成类幸存者模式。用 WASD 躲避攻击，瓦库自动出牌，撑过一段时间即胜利。目前仍在测试。
Turns Slay the Spire 2's turn-based combat into a survivor-like / bullet-heaven mode. Dodge with WASD, Waku auto-plays cards, survive for a while to win. Still in testing.
author: 普通网友Cano
name: 假如塔2是类幸存者 / Make STS2 Bullet Heaven
